name: Forest and Farm Facility: Direct Beneficiary Grants

funder.name: Forest and Farm Facility (FAO, IIED, IUCN and AgriCord)

summary: Grants to registered forest and farm producer organisations in the Facility's partner countries for farm forestry, agroforestry and landscape-based production, with a cash contribution from the organisation.

geography.label: FFF core partner and network countries

reporting: Grantees submit narrative and financial reports; later instalments are paid only after the first and final reports are cleared.

applicant_types.quote: be a registered member-based forest and farm producer organization or in exceptional circumstances a non-profit-making organization registered as local community-based organization (CBOs)

geography.quote: Core partner countries Bolivia Ecuador Ghana Kenya Madagascar Nepal Togo United Republic of Tanzania Viet Nam Zambia Network countries Colombia The Gambia Guatemala Liberia

access.quote: Applicants will be required to provide information and to present documentation to prove that they meet the eligibility criteria

amount.quote: Successful applicants will be supported with grant value ranging between USD 5 000 to USD 100 000 (maximum limit)

co_finance_required.quote: The FFPO commits to match in cash the minimum contribution to the investment of the work plan.

reporting.quote: second payment will be equal to 50% of the award, to be disbursed upon clearance of the first narrative and financial reports
